assumptions: The 'last week of October' is taken as the last 7 days, 25-31 October 2026.
Settlement is measured as gross settled amount (before refunds and fees).
caveats: Attempt volume was +39% versus the usual level for those weekdays. Sales and data gaps both look like this, so check before comparing totals across this period. It is not treated as a data error by itself and is flagged for context.
GMV on 31 October settles T+1, after the data cut-off, so settled figures for this week are understated relative to GMV until that batch arrives.

facts.text: NovaMart transaction GMV for 25-31 October 2026 was ₹43.67 crore (₹436,684,668.47).
Gross settled amount for the same period was ₹36.67 crore (₹366,716,092.10).
About ₹6.997 crore of GMV from 31 October settles T+1, after the data cut-off of 31 October, so it is not yet settled (timing).
Refunds of ₹40.86 lakh (₹4,086,230.59) were netted off settlement, and fees (MDR) were ₹50.49 lakh (₹5,048,761.76).
Net settled amount after refunds and fees was ₹35.76 crore (₹357,581,099.75).
The unexplained residual is ₹0 (0.0%), and no settlement batches were flagged.
Three multi-day batches (NovaMart Electronics, Fashion and Grocery; 25-26 Oct, settled 28 Oct) fall fully inside the window and have no net effect on the total.
Attempt volume was +39% versus the usual level for those weekdays across the 7 days.

response.headline: For 25-31 October 2026, NovaMart's transaction GMV was ₹43.67 crore against ₹36.67 crore settled gross. The gap is fully explained, mainly by 31 October's GMV settling after the data cut-off.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Check with the NovaMart team whether a sale or campaign ran during 25-31 October.
hypotheses.rationale: Volume was +39% versus usual weekday levels, which looks like a business event, but the data cannot say which.
hypotheses.text: The higher-than-usual volume may reflect a sale or promotion at NovaMart rather than a data gap.
